# pysradb

> pysradb is a Python package and command-line tool for searching public sequencing metadata across NCBI SRA, ENA, and GEO; converting accessions; linking datasets to publications; extracting identifiers from articles; and preparing reproducible SRA/ENA/GEO download workflows.

pysradb is intended for bioinformatics and genomics users who need programmatic access to public sequencing metadata and run-level download URLs. It exposes both the `pysradb` CLI and a pandas-based Python API centered on `pysradb.SRAweb`.

Current source version in this repository: `3.0.0.dev0`. The package metadata requires Python `>=3.10`. Stable installs are available with `pip install pysradb` or `conda install -c bioconda pysradb`; development installs should use `python -m pip install --editable ".[test,docs]"`.

Primary public documentation: <https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/>

Source repository: <https://github.com/saketkc/pysradb>

## Start Here

- [Documentation home](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/): Overview, quick example, citation, and top-level navigation.
- [Quickstart](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/quickstart.html): First examples for metadata, detailed metadata, accession conversion, downloads, search, and notebooks.
- [Installation](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/installation.html): Stable, conda, and source installation instructions.
- [Command-line usage](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/cmdline.html): Main CLI reference and examples for `metadata`, `download`, `search`, accession conversion, publication mapping, and enrichment.
- [Python API usage](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/python-api-usage.html): Examples using `SRAweb`, returned pandas DataFrames, downloads, metadata filtering, and sample-attribute expansion.
- [API reference](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/pysradb.html): Autodoc reference for public modules including `sraweb`, `geoweb`, `search`, `download`, `filter_attrs`, and `enrichment`.
- [MCP server](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/mcp.html): Optional local Model Context Protocol server for agent access to read-oriented metadata tools.

## Common Workflows

- [Metadata lookup](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/quickstart.html#metadata): Use `pysradb metadata SRP265425` or `SRAweb().metadata("SRP265425")` for study metadata.
- [Detailed metadata and file URLs](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/quickstart.html#metadata): Add `--detailed` in the CLI or `detailed=True` in Python to include run-level details and SRA/ENA download URLs.
- [Download planning and execution](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/quickstart.html#downloading-sequencing-data): Use `pysradb download -p SRP...`, pipe detailed metadata into `pysradb download`, or call `SRAweb().download(...)`.
- [Search SRA, ENA, and GEO](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/cmdline.html#searching-datasets): Use `pysradb search` with `--db sra`, `--db ena`, or `--db geo`, plus filters such as query text, organism, layout, platform, source, strategy, and date.
- [Accession conversion](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/cmdline.html): Convert among common GEO/SRA accessions including GSE, GSM, SRP, SRX, SRS, and SRR.
- [Publication and identifier mapping](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/cmdline.html): Map SRP/GSE/PMID/PMC/DOI identifiers and extract external dataset identifiers from PubMed Central or DOI-linked articles.
- [GEO matrix downloads](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/cmdline.html): Use `geo-matrix` or `pysradb.geoweb` helpers to download and parse GEO Series Matrix files.
- [Sample attribute expansion](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/python-api-usage.html): Use `pysradb.filter_attrs.expand_sample_attribute_columns` or CLI `--desc --expand` when sample metadata is embedded in `sample_attribute`.
- [Metadata enrichment](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/cmdline.html#enriching-metadata): Optional LLM-backed inference for standardized biological fields such as age, sex, ethnicity, phenotype, cell type, tissue, strain, and disease.
- [MCP access](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/mcp.html): Install `pysradb[mcp]` and run `pysradb-mcp` as a local stdio subprocess for MCP-capable assistants.

## Tutorials

- [Tutorials and notebooks](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/notebooks.html): Ordered learning path for Python API usage, CLI downloads, parallel download planning, subset selection, multi-project metadata, search, identifiers, enrichment, and BioScience parsing.
- [Notebooks on GitHub](https://github.com/saketkc/pysradb/tree/develop/notebooks): Source notebooks used by the documentation.
- [Case studies](https://saket-choudhary.me/pysradb/case_studies.html): End-to-end examples for dataset discovery, metadata inspection, accession conversion, and downloads.

## Source Files For Agents

- [`pysradb/sraweb.py`](https://github.com/saketkc/pysradb/blob/develop/pysradb/sraweb.py): Main Python API, including `SRAweb`, metadata retrieval, accession conversion, search, downloads, PMID/DOI/PMC mapping, and identifier extraction.
- [`pysradb/cli.py`](https://github.com/saketkc/pysradb/blob/develop/pysradb/cli.py): CLI parser, subcommands, argument names, output formatting, and command-to-API routing.
- [`pysradb/search.py`](https://github.com/saketkc/pysradb/blob/develop/pysradb/search.py): `SraSearch`, `EnaSearch`, and `GeoSearch` query builders and result parsing.
- [`pysradb/geoweb.py`](https://github.com/saketkc/pysradb/blob/develop/pysradb/geoweb.py): GEO supplementary file and Series Matrix helpers.
- [`pysradb/filter_attrs.py`](https://github.com/saketkc/pysradb/blob/develop/pysradb/filter_attrs.py): Sample-attribute expansion and simple biological metadata guessing helpers.
- [`pysradb/enrichment.py`](https://github.com/saketkc/pysradb/blob/develop/pysradb/enrichment.py): Optional metadata enrichment implementation and backend integration.
- [`pysradb/mcp_server.py`](https://github.com/saketkc/pysradb/blob/develop/pysradb/mcp_server.py): Optional MCP server exposing bounded read tools for metadata, search, accession conversion, ENA/GEO URL discovery, publication metadata, and identifier mapping.
- [`pyproject.toml`](https://github.com/saketkc/pysradb/blob/develop/pyproject.toml): Current package metadata, dependencies, optional extras, supported Python versions, and console script entry point.
- [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/saketkc/pysradb/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, test, lint, packaging, and docs build commands.
- [`HISTORY.md`](https://github.com/saketkc/pysradb/blob/develop/HISTORY.md): Release history and unreleased changes.

## CLI Summary

The console script is `pysradb`. Use `pysradb --help`, `pysradb --version`, and `pysradb --citation` for top-level help.

The optional MCP console script is `pysradb-mcp`. It defaults to local stdio transport and does not require a hosted web server.

Important subcommands:

- `metadata`: Fetch metadata for one or more SRP or GSE accessions.
- `download`: Download SRA or GEO data, optionally from piped metadata.
- `search`: Search SRA, ENA, or GEO.
- `gse-to-gsm`, `gse-to-srp`, `gsm-to-gse`, `gsm-to-srp`, `gsm-to-srr`, `gsm-to-srs`, `gsm-to-srx`: Convert GEO accessions to related GEO/SRA accessions.
- `srp-to-gse`, `srp-to-srr`, `srp-to-srs`, `srp-to-srx`: Convert SRA project accessions.
- `srr-to-gsm`, `srr-to-srp`, `srr-to-srs`, `srr-to-srx`, `srs-to-gsm`, `srs-to-srx`, `srx-to-srp`, `srx-to-srr`, `srx-to-srs`: Convert run, sample, and experiment accessions.
- `geo-matrix`: Download and parse GEO Series Matrix files.
- `srp-to-pmid`, `gse-to-pmid`, `pmid-to-gse`, `pmid-to-srp`, `pmc-to-identifiers`, `pmid-to-identifiers`, `doi-to-gse`, `doi-to-srp`, `doi-to-identifiers`: Map publication and dataset identifiers.
- `pysradb-mcp`: Run the optional MCP server after installing `pysradb[mcp]`.

Common CLI options:

- `--saveto`: Save tabular output. `.csv`, `.json`, `.tsv`, and `.txt` are handled explicitly.
- `--detailed`: Return richer metadata or conversion results.
- `--desc`: Include `sample_attribute`.
- `--expand`: Expand `sample_attribute` fields into columns where supported.
- `--enrich`: Enable optional LLM-backed metadata enrichment for `metadata`.
- `--model`: Select enrichment backend, for example `ollama/granite4:3b`, `ollama/llama3.2`, `lmstudio/<model>`, `vllm/<model>`, or `vllm`.
- `--embed-model`: Select the embedding model for enrichment.

## Python API Summary

Prefer public imports from `pysradb` or explicit module imports:

```python
from pysradb import SRAweb, GEOweb, expand_sample_attribute_columns
```

Core Python APIs:

- `SRAweb().metadata(accession, **kwargs)`: General metadata entry point for SRP and GSE accessions.
- `SRAweb().sra_metadata(srp, detailed=False, ...)`: SRA metadata and download URLs.
- `SRAweb().geo_metadata(gse, detailed=False, ...)`: GEO metadata.
- `SRAweb().download(...)`: Download files from detailed metadata or accession-derived metadata.
- `SRAweb().search(query, detailed=False, max=20)`: SRA search convenience method.
- `SRAweb().gse_to_srp(...)`, `gsm_to_srr(...)`, `srp_to_srx(...)`, and related methods: Accession conversion helpers.
- `SRAweb().srp_to_pmid(...)`, `gse_to_pmid(...)`, `pmid_to_identifiers(...)`, `doi_to_identifiers(...)`: Publication and identifier workflows.
- `GEOweb().get_download_links(...)` and `GEOweb().download(...)`: GEO supplementary download helpers.
- `download_geo_matrix(...)` and `parse_geo_matrix_to_tsv(...)`: GEO Series Matrix helpers.
- `expand_sample_attribute_columns(df)`: Expand `sample_attribute` key-value text into DataFrame columns.

Most data-returning APIs return pandas `DataFrame` objects. Network access to NCBI, ENA, GEO, Europe PMC, OpenAlex, or DOI-linked resources may be required depending on the workflow.

## Optional Enrichment

Install enrichment dependencies with:

```bash
python -m pip install "pysradb[enrichment]"
```

The enrichment workflow uses embeddings plus an LLM backend. Supported backend prefixes in the current code and docs are `ollama/`, `lmstudio/`, and `vllm/`, plus bare `vllm`. The default backend in the current CLI is `ollama/granite4:3b`; the default embedding model is `abhinand/MedEmbed-large-v0.1`.

For Ollama-backed enrichment, install and run Ollama separately, then pull the requested model. Enrichment is optional and should not be assumed available in basic installations.

Important caveat from the current CLI implementation: `metadata --enrich` cannot be combined with `--detailed`; enrichment uses the pysraweb API output path.

## Optional MCP Server

Install MCP support with:

```bash
python -m pip install "pysradb[mcp]"
```

Run the local stdio MCP server with:

```bash
pysradb-mcp
```

MCP uses the word "server" for the tool-providing process. The default `pysradb-mcp` mode is not a hosted web server; an MCP client starts it as a local subprocess and communicates over stdin/stdout.

The server exposes read-oriented tools grouped around:

- Capability discovery: `list_capabilities`.
- Metadata and search: `get_metadata`, `get_sra_metadata`, `get_geo_metadata`, `get_gds_results`, `get_gsm_soft_metadata`, `search_datasets`.
- Accession and URL discovery: `convert_accession`, `convert_bioproject_to_srp`, `get_ena_fastq_urls`, `get_geo_supplementary_links`, `get_geo_matrix_url`.
- Publication metadata and mappings: `get_publication_info`, `get_publication_metadata`, `get_pmids_for_bioproject`, `get_pmids_for_sra_accession`, `get_pmids_for_gse`, `get_pmids_for_arrayexpress`, `get_pmids_for_ena_or_bioproject`, `convert_doi_to_pmid`, `convert_pmid_to_pmc`.
- Identifier extraction: `map_publication_identifiers`, `get_identifiers_from_pmc`, `get_identifiers_from_pmid`, `get_identifiers_from_doi`, `get_gse_from_pmid`, `get_srp_from_pmid`, `get_gse_from_doi`, `get_srp_from_doi`, `search_pmc_for_external_source`, `get_pmc_fulltext_excerpt`, `extract_identifiers_from_text`.

Bulk sequencing downloads and GEO file downloads are intentionally not exposed through MCP because they can consume substantial disk, bandwidth, and time.

## Development

- Run tests: `pytest -s -v tests` or `coverage run --source pysradb -m pytest`.
- Run lint: `flake8 pysradb tests`.
- Build docs: `make docs`.
- Build package: `python -m build`.
- Documentation uses Sphinx, Furo, MyST Markdown, nbsphinx, and autodoc.
- Tests live in `tests/` and include fixtures under `tests/data/`.

## Guidance For AI Assistants

- Prefer `pyproject.toml`, `pysradb/__init__.py`, and source code over stale packaging metadata if version or dependency information conflicts.
- Prefer public APIs exported from `pysradb.__init__` and documented `SRAweb` methods over private helper methods whose names start with `_`.
- Preserve accession terminology exactly: GSE/GSM are GEO identifiers; SRP/SRX/SRS/SRR are SRA study, experiment, sample, and run identifiers; PMID/PMC/DOI are publication identifiers; PRJNA is a BioProject identifier.
- Do not invent CLI flags. Check `pysradb/cli.py` or the command-line documentation before suggesting commands.
- Warn users before commands that download sequencing files, because datasets can be large.
- Mention that metadata/search/download workflows require internet access and depend on external public services.
- When showing pandas examples, assume results are DataFrames and can be filtered with ordinary pandas operations.
- If public docs and current source disagree, say which source was used and prefer the current repository source for code-level advice.
